utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Mara, have you heard about the repair drive this weekend at the community center? I'm bringing my old toaster!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, I've been helping organize it! Gus is bringing tools, and I'm checking on tarps for Cleo. Bring that toaster—I bet we can fix it!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that's great! I'm so glad you're involved. Any chance they can fix my toaster?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, it's Saturday 10-2 at the center. Just bring anything busted.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect! I'll let Faye know so we can sync up with the school volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, Jules. I'll see you there.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Kira, I keep hearing about a repair drive but I'm mixed up on the details. What's the deal?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A repair drive? You mean like they're going to fix things for free? That sounds too good to be true.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I think it's for fixing bikes, but I've also heard about a fence and something about school, so I'm not sure what's actually happening.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Leo, are you available to help with the repair drive this Saturday? I'm checking on times that work for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, I'll be there Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, Leo! Saturday morning works. I'll finalize the start time once I confirm with a few others.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Pia, I'm still waiting to hear back from Leo about the date.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, I thought it was this Saturday—Eli already knows. I just hope we have enough people and supplies to actually get everything done.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, I thought so too, but Leo hasn't confirmed with me yet. Maybe you can ask him?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: The repair drive? I think I left my notes somewhere... let me check.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Oren, it's this Saturday at my garage at 9 AM—we're fixing bikes for the kids at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, this Saturday at your garage! I better write that down before I forget. Thanks, Vik!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Morning, Uli. Vik's organizing a repair drive this Saturday—we're fixing up old bikes for the kids at the community center. I was just saying we might need some rope to secure things.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday, then. Good, that's set. Let's start a list of supplies and volunteers to make sure everything runs smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great idea, Eli. I'll add rope to the list, and I can bring some tools too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Nell, heard you're helping with the repair drive—I've got a van full of tools if you need anything!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that's great, Gus! I was wondering about tools. Could I maybe borrow a hammer and some screws?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Nell! I've got plenty in the van. Let me grab those for you.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: So, Noah, what kind of repair drive are we talking about? Is it for electronics or something else?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, bikes? Or maybe the fence? Honestly, I can't keep it straight.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I think it's for electronics, like the community repair event Mara mentioned. Did you sign up for something different?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Quinn, do you happen to know where I can find extra tarps and rope for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I think I saw some extra tarps in the community center's storage room. Let me check with Tess—she's been organizing supplies.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks Quinn, that would be great. Let me know what Tess says about the tarps.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I hope we can fix enough to make a difference.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I'm sure we will, especially with it being at the community center parking lot. Plenty of folks coming!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That's good to hear. I guess it's about all of us pitching in, bit by bit.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I probably won't make it myself, but it's a good cause.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's a shame, but we really appreciate your encouragement! Maybe we'll catch you at the next one.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, maybe next time. I'll be thinking of you all from home.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm just concerned that one drive might not be enough to fix everything, Mara. Do you think we have enough volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Don't worry, Pia! Gus is bringing a van full of tools, and my neighbor Sam has extra gear. We'll have plenty of hands.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I hope so, but do we have a schedule or assigned tasks? I'd hate for things to get chaotic.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I remember discussing that. What do you think about it, Vik?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, it's going to be great! We're fixing up bikes for kids at the community center this Saturday, starting at my garage at 9 AM.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Saturday at 9, got it. Do you need me to bring any tools or just show up?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait, so is the repair drive specifically for electronics, or is it also for things like fence posts and tarps? I just want to make sure I'm clear on what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Good question—I think it's for all sorts of repairs, but let me double-check with Faye to be sure. I'll get back to you!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules. I'll wait to hear from you before gathering anything.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Bo, did you hear about the repair drive this weekend at the community center parking lot? I'm bringing my broken toaster—it's gonna be great!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I heard. Saturday 10-2, right? Bring your toaster.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That's right! I've already got my toaster and a shirt with a torn seam ready. What are you bringing?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Gus, do you have any tarps and rope in your van for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mina! I've got some heavy-duty tarps and plenty of rope in the van.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks! And is the sign-up sheet for the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Opal! The repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center—still from 10 to 2. Hope you can make it!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, Sunday at the community center—10 to 2. I'll be there with my toaster.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Opal! I'm sure the volunteers can take a look at that toaster.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It's a community thing—folks are pitching in to fix up some broken fences and such.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, fences? I thought we were fixing bikes... or maybe both? Honestly, I'm a bit mixed up.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: No, it's just fences and garden stuff—no bikes, I think.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Ira, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday at the community center? We're fixing up bikes for kids!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, so it's for bikes, not the fence? Guess I mixed that up. Sounds like a good cause—need any extra hands?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, we'd love your help! The more hands, the better—bring a friend if you like!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I think I left my notes somewhere... let me check.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No worries, Oren. Take your time—I can help you look if you want.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That'd be great, Sam! I think I last had them near the garage... or was it the kitchen?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Faye, do you know if anyone in the neighborhood has spare tarps and rope for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I'm not sure offhand, but I can ask around. Sam might have some from his camping trips.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That's a good lead, Faye. Let me know what you find out.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A repair drive? You mean like they're going to fix stuff for free? That sounds too good to be true.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It's real. Gus is bringing a van of tools on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Gus is bringing tools? And who's going to actually do the fixing? I'd like to see some credentials.
